WITH sex_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.SEX, ''), '(blank)') AS sex_group,
         COUNT(*) AS examination_count
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.SEX, ''), '(blank)')
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT sex_group,
         examination_count,
         1.0 * examination_count / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS share,
         AVG(1.0 * examination_count) OVER () AS average_count
  FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT SUM(examination_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(examination_count - average_count) AS average_excess_count
FROM metrics
WHERE examination_count > average_count;
